prerequisites: BASIC ELECTRIC CIRCUIT THEORY course content, specifically: circuit components and their constitutive equations; Kirchhoff's laws and their application; Thevenin and Norton theorems.
Signals in the time and frequency domain.

learning_outcomes.text: Provide fundamental tools for the design and analysis of electronic circuits for the analogical treatment of information, with particular reference to signal amplification.
Frequency response of amplifiers in the small signals approximation.
Processing of analog signals using operational amplifiers.
Basic elements on the power supply circuits.

syllabus_topics: Operational Amplifiers (Op): The Ideal Op Amp
Effect of Finite Open-Loop Gain and Bandwidth on Circuit Performance
Operation in the Reverse Breakdown Region--Zener Diodes
MOS Field-Effect Transistors (MOSFETs): Device Structure and Physical Operation
The MOSFET as an Amplifier and as a Switch
The MOSFET Internal Capacitances and High-Frequency Model
Frequency Response of the Common Source (CS) Amplifier
IC Biasing - Current Sources, Current Mirrors, and Current-Steering Circuits
The Common-Source Amplifiers with Active Loads
The Shunt-Shunt and Shunt-Series Feedback Amplifiers
teaching_methods: Theoretical lessons on all course topics
Numerical exercises focused on the design and analysis of fundamental electronic circuits
Laboratory exercises carried out by the students and concerning the application of the topics studied during the course
assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written test and, if admitted, an oral examination. The written test assesses the student's ability to solve problems of analysis and synthesis of electronic circuits. The oral examination includes three theoretical questions on all topics covered. The score obtained in the written test serves as the basis for determining the final grade, which may increase and/or decrease depending on the score obtained in the oral examination.
bibliography: Microelectronics Circuits, A. Sedra ,K.C. Smith, T.C. Carusone, OXFORD University Press 2020.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Biomedica (Electronics And Biomedical Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
